root.label: Santa Ana police share video of puppy killing

events.label: Santa Ana police share video of puppy killing

slots.name: stoppage duration
slots.sentence: Santa Ana police said the vehicle remained stopped on top of the dog for approximately 15 seconds before leaving.

slots.name: maximum jail term
slots.sentence: Potential penalties can include up to a year in county jail for misdemeanor offenses, state prison sentences for felony convictions, and a fine of no more than $20,000, according to the Los Angeles County Animal Care and Control.

slots.name: video release date
slots.sentence: Santa Ana police found video corroborating the reporting party’s statement and shared it on social media Wednesday, Sept. 30.

slots.name: tip-line phone number
